mapper.insert: INSERT INTO result_audit (result_id, action, actor, acted_at, detail) SELECT r.id, #{action}, #{actor}, CAST(#{actedAt} AS TIMESTAMPTZ), jsonb_build_object('parameter', p.code, 'value', r.value, 'unit', r.unit, 'specMin', r.spec_min, 'specMax', r.spec_max, 'verdict', r.verdict, 'status', r.status, 'rejectReason', r.reject_reason, 'replacesId', r.replaces_id) FROM test_result r JOIN test_parameter p ON p.id = r.parameter_id WHERE r.id = #{resultId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.action, a.actor, a.acted_at, p.name AS parameter_name, a.detail ->> 'value' AS value, a.detail ->> 'unit' AS unit, a.detail ->> 'verdict' AS verdict, a.detail ->> 'rejectReason' AS reject_reason FROM result_audit a JOIN test_result r ON r.id = a.result_id JOIN test_parameter p ON p.id = r.parameter_id WHERE r.sample_id = #{sampleId} ORDER BY a.acted_at, a.id
